sections.label: Scene Breaks
sections.intro: A scene break sits on its own centered line between two scenes or chapters. Three spaced asterisks (* * *, called a dinkus) are what most manuscripts use, and ⁂ (the asterism) or a floral heart such as ❦ gives the typeset look. An e-reader whose fonts lack ⁂, ❦, ❧, ☙ or ⁕ can show an empty box in its place, which is why * * * comes first here: it is plain keyboard text, so no font can drop it.
